texts.LTEXT_TEXTUISECUENCIAS_ARROZAL_ATACANTE_: Rice terraces climb the hill and the flooded paddies reach to the river. Keep to the causeways: men who wade the paddies cannot run or charge.
The walled village on the hilltop and the farm on its terraces are our objectives. Take them both.
texts.LTEXT_TEXTUISECUENCIAS_ARROZAL_DEFENSOR_: The river and its bridges cover our front. Let the enemy struggle through the mud of the paddies.
Hold the village on the hill. From its fences we see every terrace below.
